mapper.select: SELECT `id`, `name`, `created_at` FROM `note_folder` WHERE `user_id` = #{userId} ORDER BY `created_at` ASC, `id` ASC

SELECT ft.`folder_id` AS `folder_id`, ft.`tag_id` AS `tag_id`, t.`name` AS `tag_name` FROM `note_folder_tag` ft JOIN `note_tag` t ON t.`id` = ft.`tag_id` WHERE t.`user_id` = #{userId} ORDER BY ft.`folder_id`, t.`id`

SELECT f.`id` AS `folder_id`, COUNT(DISTINCT n.`id`) AS `note_count` FROM `note_folder` f LEFT JOIN `note_folder_tag` ft ON ft.`folder_id` = f.`id` LEFT JOIN `note_tag_rel` r ON r.`tag_id` = ft.`tag_id` LEFT JOIN `note` n ON n.`id` = r.`note_id` AND n.`user_id` = f.`user_id` AND n.`deleted` = 0 WHERE f.`user_id` = #{userId} GROUP BY f.`id`
